placeholderImages.description: Featured image for the buffering guide: an original OTTV drawing of a router wired to a TV with an Ethernet cable, the TV loading a stream, and a restart symbol. Generic devices with no manufacturer marks.

Featured image for the iPhone and iPad guide: an original OTTV drawing of a tablet with a form for adding a playlist link, beside a phone playing a channel. Generic devices with no manufacturer marks.

Featured image for the Windows guide: an original OTTV drawing of a laptop with a media player window, a playlist link pasted into its address field and the pointer on Play. Generic laptop and window, no operating-system or app marks.

Featured image for the macOS guide: an original OTTV drawing of a laptop showing a player app's sign-in form for a username, password and server address. Generic laptop and window, no operating-system or app marks.

Featured image for the Samsung TV guide: an original OTTV drawing of a smart TV showing a player app with its MAC address, and a phone sending it the playlist. Generic devices with no manufacturer marks.
Featured image for the Apple TV guide: an original OTTV drawing of a TV with a player app's add-playlist screen, a streaming box and a remote. Generic devices with no manufacturer marks.
